summary: Read the complete fixed proposal, including all 17 declarations, explanation, summary and central verified signatures/axioms, and the supplied review policy. Plan two independent full-proposal reviews: one emphasizes operational semantics and invariant reconstruction; the other emphasizes exact counting, boundary cases and target quantifiers. Each must apply all three basic perspectives to every declaration and explanatory claim. The self-contained proposal needs Lean/list/finite-enumeration expertise and elementary parking combinatorics; no additional literature is presently required. Select the available GPT 6.1 Sol high-effort medium profile. With U=1 and N=2, the multi-round lower bound is 12; the proposed limit 20 preserves the policy ceiling and round limit 3. This scope plan supplies no identity approval or goal-completion judgment. The operational emphasis includes index translation, least vacancy, arrival order, failure propagation, zip length, natural subtraction and maximum-fold invariants. The counting emphasis includes labeled enumeration, every hand case and trace, row completeness, peak-witness dependence, both inequality endpoints, n=1 and n=0. Both reviewers must check all these matters, distinguish informal invariant explanations from submitted theorem claims, and compare the summary with the actual formal evidence.
